messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Shiny API Deployment issue
parts: shinyapps.io does not currently support listening on arbitrary ports and having internet traffic routed to it, so I don't believe a plumber application will function in the way one would want.

On Wednesday, September 13, 2017 at 10:03:43 AM UTC-4, Shami Gupta wrote:
I was trying to deploy a sample API on shiny server - This is my first experimentation with Shiny API.. The references I found was not very clear about the contents and deployment

To start with I was using the example in https://www.rplumber.io/

I coded the same code in the example and saved it as plumber.R
# plumber.R

#* @get /mean
normalMean <- function(samples=10){
  data <- rnorm(samples)
  mean(data)
}

#* @post /sum
addTwo <- function(a, b){
  as.numeric(a) + as.numeric(b)
}
And then tried running the same from R-Studio console as 
> library(plumber)
> r <- plumb("plumber.R")
> r$run(port=8000)
And finally executing from browser http://localhost:8000/mean

This went fine and produced the output.

Next, I was trying to deploy the same on shinyapps using rsconnect::deployAPI where it failed. I am pretty sure I have missed something and for that reason the swagger did not start.. But what is it - as the documentation that I found is not very clear. Request help. Also I am looking for a more elaborate reference for coding and deployment of shiny API.
